type.notes: Custom variable family (arcadia + arcadiaDisplay cut). Hierarchy comes from SCALE + the display cut, not weight — the whole page lives in a 360–480 band, never true bold. Slightly POSITIVE tracking (0.07–0.48px) on small/label text reads as engineered calm; display stays at normal tracking. Body 16px/24px (1.5); H1 ~49px/54px (1.1) desktop, 28px mobile.

notes: Dual-theme page: alternating dark (#171721) and light (#fff / #f4f5f9) full-bleed bands; tokens carry both grounds plus per-ground fg/muted roles. SHADOW IS DELIBERATELY NONE — depth comes from ground inversion + hairline borders + radius, not drop shadows (raw shadows array was all-zero). Accent iris #5266eb is the only saturated color (primary CTA); ghost CTAs use accent-soft tint. Pink/chip-blue are rare grace notes. Reveal rootMargin '0px 0px -35%' fires reveals 35% into the viewport. respectsReducedMotion=false in the raw probe — a real a11y gap; reference patterns add the fallback the site omits.
